notes.title: Knights and Bikes Asia release confirmed!
notes.notes:
On a mostly deserted British island, two kids go on a massive adventure. The themes are friendship, exploration and imagination! For one or two players, experience the joy of exploration like you used to back in the day in this heartwarming tale, Knights and Bikes. Confirmed for release in Asia.

Currently Japanese and Simplified Chinese translation is underway. Don't forget to add it to your wishlists!

notes.title: Knights and Bikes lands August release date
notes.notes: The lovely-looking Knights and Bikes finally has a release date - and it's soon! Steam and PlayStation 4 versions of the game will drop on Tuesday, 27th August. If you're not familiar, Knights and Bikes is an indie adventure game set on the British island of Penfurzy during the 1980s. It comes from the brains of developer Foam Sword, a studio set up by former Media Molecule employees.Knights and Bikes is a hand-painted coming-of-age story starring two kids exploring the island on their bikes and finding legendary lost treasure. Think The Goonies mixed with Tearaway by way of Costume Quest.Read more
